QuestInfo.name: [10th Anniversary Event] Enter to win a 10th Anniversary Event Invite!
QuestInfo.0: [No need to edit] A chance to get the Maple 10th Anniversary offline event invite that happens on TKTKTK! Talk to the Maple Admin if you are interested.
QuestInfo.1:
[No need to edit] Hunt the normal monsters on the field and collect 30 of the #b10th Anniversary Event Invite#k to complete the quest. Then you will be able to enter for the Maple 10th Anniversary Offline Event Invite from the MapleStory website.

#bWhat happens if you win?
#rThen have fun at the 10th Anniversary party on TKTKTK!
